doc: The violations an S438 can be written for.
Generated from South Carolina's own statute code list (Title 1 through Title 63), not hand-curated per
entry. Only the ~2% of rows the state's own list publishes a point value for carry `points`; every other
row leaves it unset rather than asserting a false zero, since most of these statutes are outside the
point schedule entirely rather than a zero-point offense. `requiresCourtAppearance` is never set here --
that determination needs legal review this generation step cannot supply. An agency serving its own list
registers over `sc-s438:violation`, which replaces this outright.
